root_cause.text: `dentry_create()` incorrectly propagated an error pointer in `path->dentry` after `atomic_open()` failure, even though `nfsd4_create_file()` later passed that pointer to `start_creating()/end_creating()`, so the parent directory unlock path was skipped in NFSD create handling.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE text says `nfsd4_create_file()` “*needs* a valid dentry so that it can unlock the parent,” but on `->atomic_create` error “it will pass an error pointer to end_creating() and the parent will not be unlocked”; the patch fixes this by changing `dentry_create()` so `path->dentry is always a valid dentry, never an error-pointer`, and the diff shows `if (IS_ERR(dentry)) dentry = orig_dentry;` after `atomic_open()`.
